title: Max Area of Island
keyIdea: Flood each island once, counting its cells. DFS sinks a land cell (sets it to 0) and returns 1 + the areas from its 4 neighbours; water or off-grid returns 0. Track the largest.

approaches.name: BFS flood, counting pops
approaches.idea: For each unvisited 1: BFS, set cells to 0 when queued, area++ per pop; best = max(best, area).
approaches.why: Each cell is queued at most once.

approaches.name: DFS that sinks and returns the area
approaches.idea: dfs(r, c): out of bounds or 0 → 0; else set 0, return 1 + dfs of 4 neighbours. maxArea = max over islands.
approaches.why: Each land cell is sunk once.

options: So neighbours that look back see water and return 0: nothing is counted twice
The number of land cells in the island part reachable from (r, c) that weren't sunk yet

quiz.q: How is this different from Number of Islands?
options: Same flood, but each flood also counts its cells and you keep the maximum
